local.title: Open Codex
local.body:
Open the ChatGPT app and switch to Codex.

If it was already open, quit it and open it again so it lists the new connection.

local.title: Open your kitchen's project
local.body:
1. Click Choose project above the prompt box.
  2. Select Eggie · {kitchen} on {ssh_host}.
  3. Click Trust folder if asked.
local.alt: Choose project, with Eggie · {kitchen} in the list

local.title: Start prompting
local.body: Describe your idea and let Codex build it.
local.alt: Screenshot · Codex prompt in a project on Eggie

local.title: Run Codex in WSL
local.body:
1. Open the Codex app and sign in. If it was already open, quit it and open it again.
  2. Open Settings.
  3. Switch the agent from Windows native to WSL.

local.title: Open the projects folder
local.body:
Click Open Codex below: it opens a new chat in the projects folder.

If the folder isn’t there:

  1. Click Add new project.
  2. Paste \\wsl.localhost\eggie-vm\opt\eggie\projects into the address bar and select the folder.
  3. Click Create, then Trust folder if asked.
local.alt: Screenshot · Adding the projects folder from eggie-vm
